MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 81

2. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 24

3. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 144

4. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 16
   C. 8
   D. 0

5. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

6. Solve for x: x + 7 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 10
   C. 17
   D. 11

7. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 24
   C. 5
   D. 25

8. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

9. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 13
   C. 37
   D. 36

10. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 17
   C. 23
   D. 19

11. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

12. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 0
   C. 64
   D. 16

13. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 14
   C. 2
   D. 48

14. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 9
   D. 82

15. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 50
   C. 7
   D. 14

16. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 29
   C. 11
   D. 3

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
